description:
Converts between the Gregorian and Julian calendars, the Julian Day Number and the three Maya counts (Tzolk'in, Haab, Long Count), any one to all the others, and searches a year range for a Calendar Round ("when was 4 Ahau 3 Kankin"). Takes exactly one starting point: a Gregorian date, a jdn, a longcount, a julian date, or a round with from and to. Two are refused.

Every conversion passes through the Julian Day Number, a single count of days. The Gregorian and Julian calendars drift apart by a different number of days each century (ten at the 1582 reform, thirteen now), and pre-reform dates are often quoted as Julian without saying so. A Calendar Round repeats every 18,980 days. States the Goodman-Martinez-Thompson constant 584283.

Results include an attribution line and a permalink.

date.description: A proleptic Gregorian date, ISO YYYY-MM-DD. Example: "2012-12-21". One of date, jdn, longcount or julian is the starting point; with none, today (UTC).

from.description: First Gregorian year of a Calendar Round search. Example: "1900". Only with round and to.

jdn.description: Julian Day Number as a whole count of days. Example: "2456283". Not a fractional Julian Date.

julian.description: A date in the Julian calendar, ISO YYYY-MM-DD. Example: "1582-10-04". For sources dated before October 1582.

longcount.description: Maya Long Count, five dot-separated places baktun.katun.tun.uinal.kin. Example: "9.12.11.5.18".

round.description: Calendar Round to search: tone, day sign, haab day, haab month. Example: "4 Ahau 3 Kankin". Needs from and to.

to.description: Last Gregorian year of a Calendar Round search. Example: "2100". A wider span takes longer to search.

name: convert_calendar_date
title: Convert a date between calendars
